whyMatters.en: Dublin/London shoegaze core; Loveless (1991) set extreme guitar blur, pitch bends, and buried vocals as a production ceiling still cited in indie.
whyMatters.zh: 都柏林/伦敦 shoegaze 核心；Loveless（1991）把极端吉他模糊、弯音与埋人声定为 indie 仍在引用的制作上限。

shortBio.en: Kevin Shields–led shoegaze; Only Shallow opens the Loveless method.
shortBio.zh: Kevin Shields 领衔的 shoegaze；Only Shallow 打开 Loveless 方法。

body.en:
Formed 1983. Isn’t Anything (1988) and Loveless (1991) on Creation Records define the sound: tremolo-arm pitch glide, sampled guitar layers, Bilinda Butcher/Shields vocal blend low in the mix.

Only Shallow (1991) is the entry cut—drums upfront, guitars as harmonic fog. Studio time and Shields’s process are part of the historical object; the musical claim is texture as composition.
body.zh:
1983 年组建。Creation 厂牌上的 Isn’t Anything（1988）与 Loveless（1991）定义声音：颤音臂音高滑动、采样吉他层、Bilinda Butcher/Shields 人声埋在混音低处。

Only Shallow（1991）是入口——鼓靠前，吉他作和声雾。录音室时间与 Shields 工艺是历史对象的一部分；音乐主张是把纹理当作曲。
